headline: Mbappe, Valverde goals secure 2-1 Champions League win for Real Madrid against Inter
summary: Real Madrid, led by Jose Mourinho, secured a narrow 2-1 victory at the Santiago Bernabeu, with goals from Kylian Mbappe and Fede Valverde. Inter Milan managed to pull one back but couldn't find an equalizer.
details: Real Madrid, under Jose Mourinho, defeated his former club Inter Milan 2-1 in their Champions League opener on Tuesday. The record 15-time European champions took a two-goal lead in the first half.

Kylian Mbappe opened the scoring in the 14th minute after a defensive error, swiftly firing home. Fede Valverde doubled the lead when Inter goalkeeper Josep Martinez dallied on the ball, allowing Valverde to steal it and score.
Inter Milan's Carlos Augusto scored in the 77th minute, setting up a nervy finish for Madrid. Despite their efforts, Cristian Chivu's team could not find an equalizer at the Santiago Bernabeu.
Madrid goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois made several crucial saves throughout the match, denying Inter's attempts to level the score. Jude Bellingham also missed key chances to extend Madrid's lead.

This victory marks a triumphant and entertaining start to the league phase for Mourinho, who returned to Real Madrid after two seasons without a major trophy. He previously led Inter to Champions League glory in 2010 at the same stadium.
caption:
Real Madrid secured a 2-1 victory over Inter Milan in their Champions League opener! Goals from Kylian Mbappe and Fede Valverde sealed the win.

Real Madrid, under Jose Mourinho, defeated his former club Inter Milan 2-1 in their Champions League opener on Tuesday. The record 15-time European champions took a two-goal lead in the first half.

Kylian Mbappe opened the scoring in the 14th minute after a defensive error, swiftly firing home. Fede Valverde doubled the lead when Inter goalkeeper Josep Martinez dallied on the ball, allowing Valverde to steal it and score.

Inter Milan's Carlos Augusto scored in the 77th minute, setting up a nervy finish for Madrid. Despite their efforts, Cristian Chivu's team could not find an equalizer at the Santiago Bernabeu.

Madrid goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois made several crucial saves throughout the match, denying Inter's attempts to level the score. Jude Bellingham also missed key chances to extend Madrid's lead.

This victory marks a triumphant and entertaining start to the league phase for Mourinho, who returned to Real Madrid after two seasons without a major trophy. He previously led Inter to Champions League glory in 2010 at the same stadium.

headline_marked: [[Haaland double powers Man City to victory]] over Porto in Champions League opener
headline: Haaland double powers Man City to victory over Porto in Champions League opener
summary: Erling Haaland scored twice, including a crucial stoppage-time goal, to secure a 2-0 victory for Manchester City against Porto. This strong start marks their Champions League campaign.
details: Erling Haaland scored twice as Manchester City began their Champions League campaign with a 2-0 victory at Porto. He was denied a hat-trick by a series of fine saves in the first half but broke the deadlock early in the second with a downward header.

Porto pushed the English giants back for much of the second half but lacked the quality to capitalize on City's sloppy errors. Haaland showed the difference in class by clinically slotting into the bottom corner in stoppage time to seal the win.
This victory makes Haaland City's third-highest goalscorer of all time with 167 goals. He also now boasts an impressive record of 59 Champions League goals in 59 appearances in the competition.

City's new manager, Enzo Maresca, has made a positive start to his daunting task of succeeding Pep Guardiola. Haaland remains the main man for City, having netted five times in his first four games of the new campaign.
